nina (marketing-ops): Quick alert 10 leads dropped to unassigned due to enrichment webhook timeout (15s). example log: `2026-03-25T08:02:01Z enrich timeout lead 424242`

leo (revops): is that the 15s window from last sprint?

nina (marketing-ops): yes. heavy firmo lookups sometimes exceed it. about 10 MQLs/day in worst hours.

sam (sdr): need somewhere to surface them. they just vanish from queues.

leo (revops): short fix: add HS workflow fallback after 12s -> owner=SDR_RR_fallback and tag `enrich_timedout=true`. route to SDR_Triage RR.

raj (growth): please add SF connector guard so we don't upsert system fallback owner into Salesforce. also add a 5% canary route to validate no dupes.

hubspot-bot: Task created WF-4201: "Add enrichment timeout fallback" assigned to nina (marketing-ops).

nina (marketing-ops): rolling a 5% canary for campaign utm=rr-safety now. will report counts after 3h.

leo (revops): add prometheus alert: enrich_latency_p95 > 12s or enrich_error_rate > 1% and a dashboard by campaign.
